senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גדד I) to cut, chop, lop off.—
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 4:2:9">Y. Sabb. IV, end, 7ᵃ</cite> <he>חריות שגְּדָעָן וכ׳</he> twigs which one cut off (trimming the date tree) with the intention of using them for &c. (Bab.

<cite ref="Shabbat 50a">ib. 50ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="C00246"><he>גדר</he></cite>).—Part. pass. <he>גָּדוּעַ</he>, f. <cite ref="C00188"><he>גְּדוּעָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>גְּדוּעִים</he>, <he>גְּדוּעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 75:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXV</cite>, end <he>קרני ישראל ג׳</he> the horns (power) of Israel are lopped off (checked).

senses.gloss: . Ib.; Midr. Sam. ch. V, end <he>קרנות שג׳ צדיקו וכ׳</he> the horns which the Righteous One of the world (the Lord) has lopped.

units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:7">Cant. R. to III, 7</cite> <he>נ׳ גובה וכ׳</he> (Var. <cite ref="C01379"><he>נגרע</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C01379"><he>גרע</he></cite>) Adam’s high stature was reduced. [V. <cite ref="C00454"><he>גָּוַע</he></cite>.]
